A1.justification: Both PDFs describe TAG-WM and support reliable comparison, including their figures, equations and Appendices A–B. Visual inspection confirms that v3 omits v2's Preliminaries and Method sections; this is a document deletion, not an extraction gap.

before.justification: v2 reports original watermark recovery, tamper localization, ablation and degradation robustness results in Section 5 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in Section 3, Tables 1–3, Figures 1–3 and Appendix B.

M1.justification: Both versions propose the DMJS/WLR/DVRD/TAD framework and retain the three-interval, trainable-DVRD configuration. v3 removes the detailed method exposition without reporting a changed algorithm, architecture, objective or inference procedure.

E1.justification: The prompt-generated image domain, copyright recovery and tamper-localization tasks remain unchanged. Both retain crop/drop/logo/MAT training coverage, the same four inpainting evaluation scenarios, and the degradation coverage in Appendices A–B.

E2.justification: DwtDct, DwtDctSvd, RivaGAN, EditGuard, Stable Signature, Tree-Ring and Gaussian Shading remain in the non-tampering comparison. Gaussian Shading and EditGuard remain in the tampering plots, and EditGuard remains the localization comparator.

E3.justification: The reported SD versions, 1,000-image test set, 5,000-image training dataset, 95:5 training/validation split, generation/inversion settings, metrics and training budget remain unchanged. Appendix A retains the same degradation strengths and single-degradation sampling procedure.

E4.justification: v2 Section 4.3's diagnostic comparison of measured intrinsic bit errors with modeled tampering errors disappears. The sampling/DVRD ablation, EditGuard visual cases and Appendix B degradation sweeps remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both report CLIP-Score evaluation over 10 batches with t-tests and identical uncertainty reporting in v2 Table 2/v3 Table 1. No experimental run-count, uncertainty-estimation or significance-testing practice changes.

E6.justification: v3 removes the experimentally measured intrinsic error probability of 0.14513 reported in v2 Section 4.3. Otherwise, the empirical table values, plotted curves and qualitative examples are unchanged: v2 Tables 2–4 and Figures 3–5 match v3 Tables 1–3 and Figures 1–3.

T1.justification: v3 removes the DDIM equations and approximation assumption, formal watermark definitions, distribution-preservation derivation in Equations 6–9, and tampering-error model in Equations 10–11. Neither appendix restores this mathematical foundation.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same novelty, 256-bit capacity, lossless generation, tamper robustness, localization and efficiency claims. Their scope is unchanged despite removal of supporting methodological and theoretical material.

C2.justification: v3 removes substantive explanations of VAE-preserved spatial locality, tampering-induced bit randomization, error separation, interval-boundary errors and the rationale for trainable DVRD. Experimental interpretations and explicit limitations concerning SDE schedulers, global attacks and fixed seeds remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Deleting v2 Section 4 removes message replication and ChaCha20 encryption details, watermark initialization, sampling boundaries, reconstruction rules, the DVRD UNet specification, mask binarization and majority-vote decoding instructions. Training hyperparameters, hardware disclosures and code/data links remain, but substantial reproduction information is lost.

R1.justification: Bernstein's ChaCha reference, cited for encryption in v2, is removed. The remaining cited works and positioning relative to Gaussian Shading, Tree-Ring, EditGuard and passive localization methods are unchanged after matching renumbered references.

P1.justification: The complete Preliminaries and Method sections are deleted, so v3 proceeds directly from Related Work to Experiments. This substantially changes the explanatory structure, although most surviving prose remains unchanged.

P2.justification: v2's framework diagram, interval-strategy illustration and sampling-boundary table are removed (Figures 1–2 and Table 1). The empirical figures and tables retain their content but are renumbered and reflowed. The deletion removes the principal visual explanations of the method.

improvement.justification: v3 retains the main claims and benchmark evidence while removing the detailed method section and mathematical support for distribution preservation and tamper localization. Neither appendix replaces this material. These losses substantially impair understanding, reproducibility and assessment of the central contributions, with no substantive compensating additions.
